summary: chore(content-server): remove dead grunt build steps, tailwind and app/images
description:
Because:

* The generated 404 pages are gone, so most content-server grunt steps,
  the view engine, tailwind and app/images have no input or user.

This commit:

* Deletes the dead grunt tasks and copy, htmlmin and template config.
* Removes the handlebars view engine and the page_template config.
* Removes tailwind, app/styles, app/images and the build-css script.
* Removes the unused dependencies and updates yarn.lock.

Closes FXA-14887
